create_Grouper: create a Grouper object to specify groupby instructions for a DataFrame or Series by column key or index level
create_TimeGrouper: create a TimeGrouper for resampling datetime-indexed data by a specified frequency with origin and offset options
build_Grouping: build a Grouping object that holds grouping information for a single groupby key including codes, uniques, and indices
build_get_grouper: build a BaseGrouper from a DataFrame or Series using column keys, index levels, functions, or existing Grouper objects
test_Grouping_codes: test the Grouping class codes and uniques properties that map group labels to integer codes and return unique group values
